Index resilience despite a 20% fall in its biggest weight shows breadth strength - rotation beats concentration.
One-day crash is too little data to declare trend reversal - wait for FII data and global reaction.
Consensus is dangerous: when 99% expect a fall, markets climb the wall of worry.
Markets never move in straight lines - give direction calls a horizon, not a deadline.
One good news recurs daily like bad news did in the crash - narrative tails (vaccine, stimulus) extend trends.
After months of heavy FII selling, the first sustained FII buying is a regime signal.
Big positive agreements often arrive quietly - headlines, not handshakes, move markets.
